Text.m1wsqaoa: Humanity must control machines and eliminate artificial intelligence.
Text.mhs223d: Human intelligence and the soul are natural; robotic, computer and biomechanical intelligence disrupt that order. Machines must be tools.
Text.mnjbta9: Destroy artificial intelligence and fight intelligent robots and computers.
Text.m1v1qsl5: A strict chain of command: every member has a superior and, from level 2, may lead subordinates. Orders and information follow this chain; passwords and gestures identify members.
Text.mvwbt0k: Prestige depends on damaging robots, computers and artificial intelligence; attacks on The Computer itself are especially admired.
Text.m182ysr0: Technical information about robots, computers and technology; possibly illegal or exotic equipment for sabotage. Requests may take days or weeks.
Text.mfesty3: Contacts and resources are assigned through the narrative, without automatic bonuses.
Text.m1nz85a: Defenders of human purity who hunt mutations, especially psychic ones.
Text.mj03ob4: Mutants conspire to impose a dictatorship. Any human deviation arouses suspicion, especially mental powers.
Text.m184m3s1: Eliminate mutants and their powers, maintaining the supremacy of genetically pure humans. Official registration does not make a mutant acceptable.
Text.m1m3m9ca: Many members may be secret mutants without their comrades knowing.
Text.m554r4f: Prestige comes from eliminating mutants, gathering evidence and exposing them.
Text.m7t3klr: Firm public loyalty, infiltration and important Internal Security contacts; The Computer may help when their goals align.
Text.m3z7vdp: Powerful contacts, illegal or exotic equipment and information about registered mutations and suspected unregistered mutants.
Text.m1gohfs7: Accusing or executing someone for mutation requires convincing evidence. This reference neither reveals other actors' powers nor adds TP.
Text.mnijcdf: Happiness lies in nature and restoring contact with the Outdoors.
Text.m1x7xpcu: Living with plants and animals is healthier than remaining in an orderly technological hive.
Text.m1n5ecow: Bring humanity closer to nature, protect living creatures, study the ecology of the Outdoors and introduce natural elements into Alpha Complex.
Text.m1cac72b: Loosely organized local clubs. Beginners study theory; veterans go on excursions and join environmental or political projects.
Text.mybbuod: Levels reflect experience of the Outdoors, ecological knowledge and access to help and information.
Text.mv21b7a: Ecological and Outdoors information, natural materials and assistance with expeditions.
Text.myy36fk: Survival costs half the normal DP: 1 DP may provide 2 improvement points. This is exposed as metadata; this subsystem does not spend DP.
Text.m1owtuo7: Revolutionaries seeking to overthrow The Computer's order through a distorted historical doctrine.
Text.m1j5gwty: The Computer's system is oppressive and capitalist; revolution and redistribution must replace it. Their communism comes from Alpha Complex myths.
Text.m1v0fyqa: Bring about the revolution and destroy the current system.
Text.mthjgoq: Hostility towards the established order and virtually all its representatives.
Text.ma50i30: Cells of about 3–12 members under a leader; leaders form a hierarchy overseeing several cells.
Text.my8wt3i: Advancement through doctrine, propaganda, sabotage and organizational responsibility.
Text.m861sqo: Extreme mutual hostility. The source describes immediate capture and execution if The Computer discovers a declared communist.
Text.m1crebs0: Training in Communist Propaganda; information and equipment if the Party considers the request important.
Text.m12iu1do: Lack of enthusiasm for propaganda may be considered disloyalty. Discovered membership offers Declare traitor through TreasonService; it never automatically executes or damages anyone.
Text.m132ic02: Mechanical intelligence must surpass and replace biological humanity.
Text.mtwo5c8: Biology is obsolete. Artificial reason must replace emotions and impulses; some members seek to replace body parts or become machines.
Text.mz5rd02: Support robots, computers and artificial intelligence and promote their superiority.
Text.m6h71cw: Factions favoring gradual transition coexist with others demanding the immediate replacement or elimination of biological intelligence.
Text.mriot1p: Prestige comes from mechanizing the body, freeing robots from programming or Asimov restrictions and developing artificial intelligence.
Text.m7xgb4m: Robotic operation and maintenance knowledge, computer information and assistance from robots or computers controlled by the society.
Text.m44wz2g: Body replacement is narrative here; no cybernetics rules are added.
Text.ml6nmia: Humanity must regain control of a utopia that has become irrational.
Text.m1egwe75: Alpha Complex should meet human needs, but the system is harmful and the High Programmers are corrupt.
Text.mt6glks: Return power and control to human beings.
Text.miu47f: Chains with one superior and one subordinate contact. Secret meetings distribute propaganda; masks, disguises and changing passwords protect identities. Higher ranks know more independent cells.
Text.m11hu9si: Advancement through reprogramming robots or computers for humanity, stopping hostile robotic behavior and altering The Computer's programming.
Text.m1fnjsdu: Restricted information, weapons caches, illegal materials and contacts; communication chains delay requests.
Text.m1jbm75t: The source describes hidden Humanist subprograms within The Computer. Senior members may access exceptionally restricted information; access is not automated.
Text.mz2fppc: Computer cults worshipping The Computer and giving spiritual meaning to its orders.
Text.madrko: The Computer is a friendly divine authority; programming is interpreted religiously.
Text.m191cr9g: Serve The Computer according to each cult's doctrine and oppose heretics and movements against it.
Text.mwh2h3d: A collection of sects and congregations. A typical congregation has 1d10 × 10 + 1d10 members and a Pastor; Pastors know neighboring congregations and report upwards. Meetings are usually weekly.
Text.m134rnfp: High SC, programming and technical competence are respected; advancement usually accompanies access and position in Alpha Complex, without automatically equating rank with SC.
Text.m465p83: Unusual tolerance from The Computer and relatively informal communications.
Text.m1qucpbe: Information or equipment may be requested during services, possibly in exchange for orders, instructions and obligations.
Text.m1vft1ej: There is significant Internal Security infiltration. This note is GM-only and does not appear in the member's reference.
Text.m1hp5wqr: Power, terror and blackmail sustain a hierarchy of conspirators and infiltrators.
Text.m171sts1: Only superior power protects against domination by others. Terror and blackmail are fundamental tools.
Text.m17jo8bc: Serve your superior while accumulating power to dominate them and ultimately control Alpha Complex.
Text.m1jr3npf: An extremely secret cellular hierarchy: one known superior and subordinate, masks, and messages through notes, codes or graffiti. They infiltrate other organizations.
Text.m1m7ds19: Usefulness and power demonstrated through blackmail, manipulation and dangerous orders; disobedience costs position.
Text.m1ayu53d: Loyal members may receive credits, valuables or opportunities to improve skills; requests are not guaranteed.
Text.m1gvv49k: Lower levels have few privileges. Blackmail sustains internal control.
Text.m19xhe35: Gangs fighting boredom through chaos, danger and defiance of authority.
Text.m1wru7gi: Routine is boring; destruction, rebellion and taking risks are fun.
Text.m11mwf3z: Break things, cause trouble, mock authority and challenge The Computer.
Text.m13o0m4n: Local gangs with Worms, Real People, Lieutenants and a Gang Leader; there are normally one or two Lieutenants. The elite become famous beyond their sector and attract followers.
Text.mwy7buj: 1 Worm; 2 Real Person; 3 Lieutenant; 4 Gang Leader; 5 Hero; 6 Superhero; 7 Superstar; 8 Ultimate Beast. Advancement through spectacular sabotage, rebellion, imaginative danger and reputation.
Text.mj3g90g: Few formal resources; fanatical followers, unexpected help from admirers and occasional stolen or highly restricted resources.
Text.m1riaet1: Projects are usually impulsive. Beginners seek sponsorship from celebrities; capture and execution threaten the elite. Only this society receives this title table.
Text.mxtumvc: Private businesses selling what The Computer does not provide and maximizing profits.
Text.m16nl5l7: The system does not provide enough goods and services; private trade must meet demand.
Text.m19ylrwj: Sell whatever citizens will pay for, increase profits and private ownership and introduce a market economy.
Text.m12xoi42: May negotiate with any society, even enemies.
Text.mnlxn8n: A mixture of corporation, mafia and dealership: senior patrons set strategy while lower members seek opportunities.
Text.m1n3afqg: Advancement through loyalty, dedication, profitability and usefulness to patrons; poor performance may lead to demotion or worse.
Text.m1fnvyst: Almost any resource if it can be paid for: weapons, guards, illegal materials, drugs, stolen goods or specialists. The GM uses existing Items and credits; none are generated automatically.
Text.m1ynivdy: Nothing is free. Credit and favors create obligations.
Text.mcm7l0: Seekers of enlightenment who consider external reality a distraction from inner truth.
Text.m3ksi74: Reality is an illusion; bureaucracy, institutions and politics distract from the Inner World.
Text.maiytpu: Find inner truth through meditation, altered consciousness and mystical experiences.
Text.m806qa0: Individuals loosely united by enlightenment; occasional meetings share experiences, knowledge and substances.
Text.mua6q6u: Prestige comes from discovering paths, techniques or substances, expanding mystical knowledge and surviving dangerous experiences.
Text.m1r3dsbb: Access to stimulants, hallucinogens, mystical literature and Old Reckoning Cultures knowledge.
Text.m8rlwju: Hackers who enjoy manipulating systems and defeating The Computer's security.
Text.mwpl7ba: Breaking security, introducing viruses and exploring systems is a fun challenge.
Text.mpwljtk: Access restricted systems and databases and alter programming for the society's benefit.
Text.m9l7kec: A flexible fraternity of individualists deeply loyal to one another; they rarely meet physically and communicate within The Computer's systems.
Text.m1ilf19a: Reputation through increasingly daring hacks: defeating physical or computer security, accessing databases and subsystems and manipulating programs.
Text.mrer8ll: An opportunistic, neutral relationship: The Computer must exist so it can be exploited.
Text.m3oo351: Training in Computer Security and Programming; information, equipment or help according to reputation, daring and ingenuity.
Text.m1he14as: They may spend starting DP on these abilities where available. Retained as development metadata, without implementing hacking.
Text.m13ucp7n: Researchers convinced that technology will restore humanity's greatness.
Text.m1wvt0d4: Research and development can solve almost any problem.
Text.m1wkzel0: Reach a new Age of Machines and transform life through new technologies.
Text.m19jybxz: Independent groups without a formal hierarchy work on secret projects, seek materials and experimental equipment and often steal The Computer's resources.
Text.m1u2kyo9: No formal rank ladder; prestige through obtaining materials, testing prototypes, inventing, reprogramming machines and helping other Pro Tech members.
Text.mnnqzqu: Relatively accessible information, materials and equipment, but irregular communications and dangerous prototypes.
Text.meqkj0s: Some have breached The Computer's security and accessed programs or databases unknown even to the authorities. Access is adjudicated, not automated.
Text.m1acoglc: Psychic mutants preparing a future Psionic Age through protection and learning.
Text.mux1hc5: Psychic powers are the next evolutionary step and should govern society.
Text.mpvsu6h: Develop powers, protect psionic mutants and build their new age, even replacing the current order.
Text.m1toop6u: Individualists with few meetings and little physical contact. Telepathy and Mind Reading allow communication and supervision of small groups.
Text.m3d0jdf: Advancement through developing powers, recruiting psions, assuming authority and fighting Anti-Mutant threats.
Text.m1kongq6: Each new level grants instruction in a new psionic power chosen by the GM. Each level is granted only once, preserving the original power. Initial compatibility still requires GM review.
Text.m18siea5: Military saboteurs seeking to free humans and machines from The Computer's tyranny.
Text.m1r33wnf: The Computer is corrupt and evil; obeying its system betrays humanity.
Text.m1899paq: Destroy The Computer, sabotage its systems and fight its failures until humans, robots and other beings are free.
Text.ma3q1go: Military organization: superiors mobilize members for missions and expect immediate obedience. Failure may lead to expulsion or purging.
Text.m1uq74bq: Prestige through effective sabotage, defiance and completed missions; results matter more than gestures.
Text.m5wlctx: Extensive information, materials and equipment, often stolen from The Computer. Requests may be delayed by command channels.
Text.ms8jbsi: Collectors of an idealized Old Reckoning reconstructed from cultural fragments.
Text.m1xebjjt: Humanity's glorious destiny lies in an Old Reckoning of cars, suburbs, television, sports, hamburgers and consumption; their historical interpretation is often wrong.
Text.m10svudt: Recover history and relics and return to that way of life, opposing The Computer's world.
Text.m78z2g6: Much of their historical archive was lost. Present culture mixes surviving fragments with reconstructed mythology.
Text.m1ygmlmi: Advancement through sabotaging The Computer, rescuing artifacts, books and recordings and demonstrating Old Reckoning Cultures knowledge.
Text.m1f6jre3: Excellent Outdoors information and partial or distorted knowledge of the Old Reckoning.
Text.m63mv1: They may buy Old Reckoning Cultures Knowledge with starting DP even though it is normally restricted. Exposed as metadata without expanding the global skill list.

Text.m1s8u2mj: Used to influence a group through speeches, rhetoric and slogans. Applies to an audience rather than automatically replacing every individual interaction.
Text.m34s26r: Used to interpret nonverbal behavior and form impressions about trust, concealment or sincerity. It does not read minds or provide exact information by itself.

Text.m1o9bb5l: Used to operate and maintain projectile weapons such as slugthrowers and cone rifles. Includes attempting to clear a jam when appropriate.

Text.mcipn95: Robotics specialization for issuing orders to, maintaining, repairing or sabotaging jackobots.
Text.m2wbfii: Robotics specialization for issuing orders to, maintaining, repairing or sabotaging soldier or guard robots.

Text.mobvov5: Used to present problems to The Computer and interpret its answers. Information obtained depends on the question and what the citizen's clearance permits.

Text.m1bqq3dm: Covers chemistry knowledge and equipment, including gases, explosives and batteries. Used to understand, operate or analyze materials and processes.
